description: SUPERGRAPH CONDUCT VALUATION (block 282000). The town is a supergraph (a level of selection above the individual); a directed action's value is the actor's own stake (plan_base) PLUS the target's fulfilment change (target_effect) weighted by how much the actor cares about that target -- a SIGNED per-pair weight bond_w (from the Bond) scaled by the global psychopathy gate ep.w_supergraph. ONE action-type-agnostic rule conduct_supergraph_value replaces the three hand-tuned conduct_couple_* rules (281000): plan_value = plan_base + (ep.w_supergraph*bond_w)*target_effect, bond_w = altruism_bias + k*affect_affection - k*affect_resentment. Revives the DEAD Bond slot altruism_bias (the per-pair care prior), adds the per-agent psychopathy knob (w_supergraph=0 -> weights no one), and gives spite a principled per-pair form (negative bond_w). Term shape = coll_evict bc_pick_cheapest_hands (the only existing multiplicative w_supergraph*magnitude); ZERO new Rust. target_effect published per directed DecAction by the world adapter. Load INSTEAD OF bigville_conduct (both write plan_value). self_load_only.

rules.name: conduct_supergraph_value
rules.comment: SUPERGRAPH CONDUCT VALUATION (block 282000). One action-type-agnostic rule replacing the three conduct_couple_* rules: a directed action's plan_value = plan_base + (ep.w_supergraph * bond_w) * target_effect, bond_w = altruism_bias + k*affect_affection - k*affect_resentment. The town is a supergraph -- the actor weights the target's fulfilment change (target_effect) by how much it cares about that target (signed per-pair bond_w) scaled by the global psychopathy gate (ep.w_supergraph). Sign lives in target_effect (harm<0, help/transfer>0), so a negative bond_w (resentment) times a negative harm-effect scores harming a rival UP, while helping a friend (positive*positive) scores UP. Matches the existing conduct edges (in_scene/aims_at/holds_bond/toward) + the actor's EmotionParams (has_ep). Only fires on DIRECTED actions (aims_at present). Term shape = bigville_coll_evict.json bc_pick_cheapest_hands. ZERO new Rust. FALSIFIER: conduct_k=0 AND altruism_bias=0 -> bond_w=0 -> plan_value=plan_base -> no directedness. PSYCHOPATHY: ep.w_supergraph=0 -> no per-pair care at all.
